title: የቡና ግዢ ዋጋ ማስታወቂያ
key_sentences: ዩኒየኑ ለ2019 ዓ.ም. የምርት ዘመን የቡና ግዢ ዋጋ እንደሚከተለው ወስኗል።
The Union has set the following purchase prices for the 2026/27 harvest.
ዋጋው ከጥቅምት 1 ቀን 2019 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ ተግባራዊ ይሆናል።
አባላት ቡናቸውን በአቅራቢያቸው ባለው መሰብሰቢያ ጣቢያ ማስረከብ አለባቸው።
Members must deliver their coffee to the nearest collection station.

rows: ቀይ እሸት ቡና Red cherry, fully ripe
ቀይ እሸት ቡና (ድብልቅ) Red cherry, mixed ripeness

list_items.text: ፩. ቡናው በደንብ የበሰለና ቀይ መሆን አለበት።
፪. ቡናው ከአፈርና ከባዕድ ነገሮች የጸዳ መሆን አለበት።
፫. እያንዳንዱ አባል የአባልነት መታወቂያውን ይዞ መቅረብ አለበት።
Cherries must be fully ripe and red.
Coffee must be free of soil and foreign matter.
Each member must bring his or her membership card.

furniture: የደጋ ብርሃን ቡና አምራቾች ኅብረት ሥራ ማኅበራት ዩኒየን
Dega Birhan Coffee Farmers’ Cooperative Union
notes: Bilingual Amharic (Ethiopic script) and English. The letterhead (circle seal drawing, union name in Amharic and English, phone/box line) is furniture. The English line under the title is a subtitle paragraph, not a heading. Each Amharic paragraph is followed by its English translation in smaller grey type. Table header cells and body cells hold two lines (Amharic, then English) joined with a space. "1ኛ" etc. mix a Western digit with an Ethiopic ordinal suffix. The Amharic delivery rules are a typed list with Ethiopic numerals ፩. ፪. ፫.; the English rules are a CSS-drawn bullet list. Sentences end with the Ethiopic full stop ። (U+1362). The page footer "ገጽ n / Page n" is a CSS margin box.
